intro: The Algaz Gauntlet is an urgent military mission to fight through Dun Algaz, a critical mountain pass linking Loch Modan to the Wetlands. Orcs of the Dragonmaw clan have entrenched themselves in the tunnels, threatening to sever Ironforge's vital lifeline to Menethil Harbor. Adventurers are tasked with cutting down the orcish vanguard and delivering word of the invasion to Valstag Ironjaw.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Orcs of the Dragonmaw clan have a haven in the Wetlands. And now they have expanded into Dun Algaz! We can't let them keep their foothold here or Loch Modan will be cut off from Menethil Harbor, our port and stronghold in the Wetlands.
Break through Dun Algaz to the Wetlands beyond, and kill some orcs for good measure! Report to Valstag Ironjaw in Menethil Harbor.
Menethil is through Dun Algaz, then north along the road, then west at the fork.
We're counting on you, friend. Do not fail.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You're coming from Loch Modan? How is the orc situation at Algaz Gate?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your report is full of bad news!
I see the Dragonmaws are making a strong move into Algaz. Normally the Dragonmaws just hide up in the hills. What made them surge into Algaz is still a mystery...
Thank you, friend. And we'll probably want your help dealing with these orcs.
